_comment: Editorial content for NNAR. This is a REIT scheme, not an operating company: it is a trust managed by a licensed REIT Management Company, so the fields below describe the scheme and its manager. It has no products of its own. Every fact is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached.
description: Naya Nazimabad Apartment REIT (NNAR) is a closed-end, Shariah-compliant developmental REIT scheme with a limited life of indicatively ten years, established under a trust deed of 24 June 2022 between Arif Habib Dolmen REIT Management Limited, as the REIT Management Company, and the Central Depository Company of Pakistan Limited, as trustee. It was formed to develop and sell three assets: seven commercial plots of about 46,597 square yards in Naya Nazimabad, Karachi; 216 plots (146 residential, 70 commercial) of about 73,871 square yards in Bankers Avenue Cooperative Housing Society on Bedian Road, Lahore; and 76 retail shops of about 12,249 square feet in IT Tower, Hali Road, Gulberg, Lahore. Its fund size is PKR 10.7175 billion across 293,750,000 units of PKR 10 each, and it listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange on 17 September 2026.
headOffice: Arif Habib Centre, 23 M.T. Khan Road, Karachi, Pakistan
sourceNote: Naya Nazimabad Apartment REIT Offer for Sale Document (PSX-hosted, 2026) and the PSX Data Portal security record for NNAR, read 2026-10-17.
